function questionBt(player, value, id)
    local kw = self.UI.getAttribute(id, 'text')

    if string.find(id, 'standard') then
        if standard_list[kw] == nil then return end
        bt0_nextDlg = standard_list[kw]
        showDialog(dlgInfo[bt0_nextDlg])
        self.UI.setAttribute(id, 'onClick', 'questionBt_deactivated')
        self.UI.setAttribute(id, 'color', '#666666')
    else
        if clue_list[kw] == nil then return end
        local target = nil
        if familiarName == 'Misaki' and pcName == 'Asahi' then
            target = 'Partner'
        elseif familiarName == 'Nyachi' and pcName == 'Sagiri' then
            target = 'Partner'
        elseif familiarName == 'Yukari' and pcName == 'Hayato' then
            target = 'Partner'
        elseif familiarName == 'Harakiri' and pcName == 'Yuya' then
            target = 'Partner'
        elseif familiarName == 'Louis' and pcName == 'Ririsu' then
            target = 'Partner'
        else
            target = 'Other'
        end
        bt0_nextDlg = clue_list[kw][target]
        showDialog(dlgInfo[bt0_nextDlg])
        self.UI.setAttribute(id, 'onClick', 'questionBt_deactivated')
        self.UI.setAttribute(id, 'color', '#666666')
    end
end

end

function setFace(Code)
    if Code == lastFaceCode then
        return
    else
        lastFaceCode = Code
    end
    local uiids = {'faceStand', 'faceSmile', 'faceSad', 'faceEmba', 'faceAngry', 'faceLaugh', 'faceEnd', 'faceEndSpeak',
    'faceOutSmile', 'faceOutSad', 'faceOutEmba', 'faceOutLaugh', 'faceOutEnd', 'faceOutEndSpeak', 'faceUnleashedEnd', 'faceUnleashedEndSpeak'}
    for i = 1, #uiids do
        if uiids[i] == Code then
            self.UI.setAttribute(uiids[i], 'active', 'true')
        else
            self.UI.setAttribute(uiids[i], 'active', 'false')
        end
    end
end



function showDialog(input)
    if input.f_next < 0 then
        bt0_nextDlg = bt0_nextDlg + 1
    else
        bt0_nextDlg = input.f_next
    end
    if input.f_result1 <= 0 then
        bt1_nextDlg = bt0_nextDlg
    else
        bt1_nextDlg = input.f_result1
    end
    if input.f_result2 <= 0 then
        bt2_nextDlg = bt0_nextDlg
    else
        bt2_nextDlg = input.f_result2
    end

    if input.f_choice1 == '' then
        self.UI.setValue('content', input.f_text)
        if input.f_next == 0 then
            self.UI.setAttribute('nextButton', 'active', 'false')
        else
            self.UI.setAttribute('nextButton', 'active', 'true')
        end
    else
        self.UI.setAttribute('nextButton', 'active', 'false')
    end
    if input.f_choice1 ~= '' and input.f_choice2 ~= '' then
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_0', 'active', 'false')
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_1', 'active', 'true')
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_2', 'active', 'true')
        self.UI.setValue('speak_content_1', input.f_choice1)
        self.UI.setValue('speak_content_2', input.f_choice2)
    elseif input.f_choice1 ~= '' and input.f_choice2 == '' then
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_0', 'active', 'true')
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_1', 'active', 'false')
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_2', 'active', 'false')
        self.UI.setValue('speak_content_0', input.f_choice1)
    else
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_0', 'active', 'false')
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_1', 'active', 'false')
        self.UI.setAttribute('speak_panel_2', 'active', 'false')
    end
    if input.f_facecode ~= '' then
        setFace(input.f_facecode)
    end
end
